title: Readings at the alert, drive-end bearing housing
excerpt: Drive-end bearing housing: vibration velocity 8.4 mm/s RMS (demo limit 4.5), temperature 78 °C (demo limit 75), motor current 12.1 A (demo limit 14).
englishExplanation: Vibration and temperature are above their demonstration limits on this motor. Current is within its limit.
limitation: Synthetic demo readings. They show what is high, not why.

title: Bearing wear after high vibration
excerpt: High vibration reported on M-204. The shaft ran rough when turned by hand and the drive-end bearing had play. On opening the housing, the outer race showed wear. Bearing replaced.
englishExplanation: A past high-vibration event on this motor was traced to a worn bearing.
limitation: A past incident is a possible explanation only. It does not show what is happening now.

title: Schmierungsproblem bei erhöhter Vibration
excerpt: Erhöhte Vibration an M-204 festgestellt. Schmierstoffstand am Lager unter der Markierung, Ursache war unzureichende Schmierung. Schmierstoff nachgefüllt, Vibration danach im Normalbereich.
englishExplanation: Increased vibration on M-204 was traced to insufficient bearing lubrication, with the lubricant below the mark. After lubricant was topped up, vibration returned to the normal range.
limitation: A past incident is a possible explanation only. The English text is a prepared explanation, not an approved translation.

title: Gearbox oil seal leak with vibration
excerpt: Vibration noted at G-204 during a routine round. An oil seal on the gearbox output shaft was leaking. Seal replaced.
englishExplanation: A vibration event on the gearbox was traced to a leaking oil seal.
limitation: This describes the gearbox, not the motor. It does not mention M-204.

title: Conveyor drive alignment check
takeaway: Conveyor alignment drifted after belt change
excerpt: Assembly check on C-204: drive train alignment between components drifted after belt replacement. Misalignment on this conveyor can raise vibration across the drive train.
englishExplanation: Alignment on the parent conveyor has drifted before, and misalignment can raise vibration in the drive train.
limitation: This describes the whole conveyor. It is context and does not describe this motor directly.

title: Shift note: motor on line 2 noisy
excerpt: Motor on line 2 noisy near end of shift.
englishExplanation: A technician noted a noisy motor on line 2 without saying which one.
limitation: Unverified technician observation. Line 2 has more than one motor, so this may not be about this asset.

title: SOP-014 Inspektion Antriebsmotor, Revision C
excerpt: Vor Beginn der Inspektion ist der Motor nach dem standortgenehmigten Verfahren freizuschalten und gegen Wiedereinschalten zu sichern.
englishExplanation: Before the inspection starts, the motor must be isolated and locked out using the site-approved procedure. The SOP then covers bearing, lubrication and alignment checks.
limitation: Synthetic procedure for demonstration. The English text is a prepared explanation, and the German text is the authoritative version.

steps.title: Lock out the motor
steps.original: Motor nach dem standortgenehmigten Verfahren freischalten und gegen Wiedereinschalten sichern, bevor die Inspektion beginnt.
steps.english: Isolate and lock out using the site-approved procedure before the inspection.

steps.title: Check the bearing
steps.original: Lagergehäuse auf der Antriebsseite auf Hitzespuren und Spiel prüfen. Welle von Hand drehen und auf raues Laufen achten.
steps.english: Turn the shaft by hand. Feel for heat, roughness or play.
steps.checkPhrase: feel for rough running or play

steps.title: Check lubrication
steps.original: Schmierstoffstand und Zustand des Schmierstoffs am Lager prüfen.
steps.english: Check lubricant level and condition at the bearing.
steps.checkPhrase: look for low or dirty lubricant

steps.title: Check alignment
steps.original: Ausrichtung zwischen Motor und Getriebe an der Kupplung prüfen.
steps.english: Check motor-to-gearbox alignment at the coupling.

steps.title: Record and release
steps.original: Beobachtungen festhalten. Anlage erst nach Freigabe gemäß Standortverfahren wieder in Betrieb nehmen.
steps.english: Record what you saw. Return to service only after site release.

title: SOP-014 Inspektion Antriebsmotor, Revision B
excerpt: Motor freischalten. Lagergehäuse prüfen. Ausrichtung prüfen.
englishExplanation: An older revision: isolate the motor, check the bearing housing, check the alignment. It has no lubrication check.
limitation: Superseded by revision C. Do not use for inspection.

title: SOP-022 Motor inspection
excerpt: Isolate and lock out M-310 using the site-approved procedure before inspection. Check bearing housing and mounting bolts.
englishExplanation: The current inspection procedure for motor M-310.
limitation: Synthetic procedure for demonstration. Applies to M-310 only.

steps.title: Lock out the motor
steps.original: Isolate and lock out M-310 using the site-approved procedure before inspection.
steps.english: Isolate and lock out M-310 using the site-approved procedure before inspection.

steps.title: Check bearing and bolts
steps.original: Check the bearing housing and mounting bolts.
steps.english: Check the bearing housing and mounting bolts.

title: Filler nozzle blockage
excerpt: Filler F-118 stopped on low flow. Nozzle 3 was blocked and was cleared.
englishExplanation: A past stoppage on this filler was caused by a blocked nozzle.
limitation: A past incident is a possible explanation only.
